tokens.name: orange
tokens.usage: Pure Orange, brand primary. Marketing field (flyers, posts), buttons and accents in the app. All text on orange is white and bold, 18px or larger; small text never goes on orange.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Bright Violet. Same rule in light and dark: it highlights, it never acts. Offers, promos and news, small and punctual, at most one violet element per screen. Never a button. White text on it passes at all sizes.

tokens.name: gray-dark
tokens.usage: Very Dark Gray. The PET word of the logo on orange, and body text on light grounds.

tokens.name: gray-light
tokens.usage: Light gray. Light surfaces and dividers (added by us, not in the 2024 manual).

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: White. BOSS24 in the logo on orange, text on orange, violet and dark.

tokens.name: app-bg
tokens.usage: App and landing page background (from the Bubble app; confirm token value in Bubble).

tokens.name: app-surface
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets on the dark background (from the Bubble app; confirm token value in Bubble).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, chips and sheets on bg.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text: dates, descriptions, hints. #B3B3B3 on dark, #6B6B6B on light. Never for buttons or titles.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Marketing headline on the orange field. Flyers used 96 to 124px.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section and service titles, phone number.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Running text. For numbers that must line up (price, time, distance) add font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels: Poppins bold 18px, white on orange.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and label, inside chips, inner containers' side padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of groups, sheets and cards in the app.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between blocks. Also the side padding of buttons (top and bottom 14px).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Pieces nested inside a padded 14px container (QR tile, inner image).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: The standard radius: buttons, inputs, cards, sheets. Taken from the app, where everything is 14px.

tokens.name: shadow-none
tokens.usage: The system is flat: no shadows. Depth comes from the surface color (bg, then surface).
